lockup.secondaryLine: Your voice. Your rights. Your community.

accessibility.target: WCAG 2.2 AAA where feasible; never knowingly below AA without flagging
rules: Do not rely on colour alone
Do not use Justice Gold for ordinary text on light backgrounds
Use structural indicators in addition to colour for active states
Use the monochrome or reversed logo when context requires stronger contrast
Logo images must have an accessible name on the containing link or image

aiInstructions: Treat this manifest and the Voice of Disability v1.2 brand skill as authoritative.
Do not redraw, invent, or substitute the Concept A mark without explicit approval.
Prefer the horizontal logo in headers and the mark for app icon/favicon contexts.
Use the reversed logo only on Voice Navy or another verified dark background.
Keep all logo source assets as SVG so AI coding tools can inspect and edit them directly.
